card.name: Protest words before the thing opposed
card.fires_on: The word 'against' (or 'to' after 'resistance' or 'opposition') right after movement, mobilization or campaign words. It marks what a protest is aimed at, often a trade agreement or privatization.

modes.label: Against after protest nouns
modes.description: 'against' follows words like mobilizations, movement or campaigns, just before the target of the protest.
modes.example: Large mobilizations<< against>> the US-Peru Free Trade Agreement

modes.label: Opposition or resistance to
modes.description: 'to' follows opposition or resistances and introduces what is being resisted.
modes.example: TOMORROW: Opposition<< to>> the caucus in 1763

card.writes: It pushes toward words of compulsion or forcing, which fits a setting of coercion and opposition.
card.plain: It fires on the word that introduces what a protest movement is opposing, such as 'against' after mobilizations.
evidence: campaigns<< against>> privatization, such as the campaign
